An '''individual''' was alive around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. At some point during that war, the individual [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Upper Shadowlands]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The individual possessed a [[Zabrak Tystel Mark III]] and a [[Krath Double Sword]] at the time of their death.
